AttemptOut.description:
One attempt. While a hidden assessment runs, the reflection fields,
signals and report of completed attempts are null (SPEC §9).
AttemptOut.title: AttemptOut

Context.description: `mixed` is the hidden assessment (SPEC §9); everything else is `targeted`.
Context.title: Context

Desk.description:
GET /desk. During a hidden assessment only `hidden_assessment` and
`active_attempt` are filled ("Assessment in progress" + Resume).
Desk.title: Desk

Difficulty.description: LeetCode's difficulty label. AtCoder problems may have none.
Difficulty.title: Difficulty

DraftPatch.description:
Send `solution_path` with a path to link (and copy) a file, or with null
to switch to the in-app editor.
DraftPatch.title: DraftPatch

HintReply.description:
The tutor's reply. Hints append to the attempt's notes, which bumps its
version; the client must adopt `attempt_version` and `notes`.
HintReply.title: HintReply

Lane.description: A section of the daily plan (SPEC §10).
Lane.title: Lane

Language.description: Solution languages (SPEC §6.2). No C++ or Java (§2.4).
Language.title: Language

ListPatch.description:
Own lists only. `problem_ids` is the full new order (drop an id to
remove it); `add_text` resolves and appends more entries.
ListPatch.title: ListPatch

PlanItemKind.description:
A plan item's kind. A transfer check has no kind (None), which is
what makes its attempt `mixed` (SPEC §6.2).
PlanItemKind.title: PlanItemKind

PlanItemOut.description: A plan row. `review_of` is never sent: it would give a transfer check away.
PlanItemOut.title: PlanItemOut

ProblemBrief.description:
Enough to show a row and link out. Never carries topic, tags or patterns,
so it is safe inside a hidden assessment.
ProblemBrief.title: ProblemBrief

ProblemPatch.description:
Send `topic_id` to override the primary topic (null = "None"); send
`reset_topic: true` to go back to the automatic topic.
ProblemPatch.title: ProblemPatch

Result.description: An attempt's level classification (SPEC §7.2), weakest first.
Result.title: Result

TutorErrorKind.description: Why an AI panel can't show output (SPEC §12.1).
TutorErrorKind.title: TutorErrorKind
